title: Step Functions with Lambda and SQS (orchestrated workers)
hook: Step Functions can invoke Lambda synchronously in a Task state, push work to SQS for async workers, or pause with waitForTaskToken until an SQS consumer reports back — combining orchestration with queue-based scale.

blocks.text: Sync Lambda Task: Resource arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke waits for response. SQS sendMessage Task dispatches to worker queue without waiting. waitForTaskToken pattern embeds $$.Task.Token in SQS message; worker calls SendTaskSuccess when done — Step Functions resumes. Combines durable orchestration with horizontally scaled consumers.

blocks.text: Sync Lambda for every step chains cold starts and 15-minute limits. SQS workers handle bursty heavy work while Step Functions tracks overall saga state. Token timeout without heartbeat fails execution — tune HeartbeatSeconds for long approvals.

blocks.title: Interview framing
blocks.body: Say: sync Lambda for quick steps; SQS + task token for long or human work; worker calls SendTaskSuccess with token from message.

blocks.title: Pitfalls to avoid
blocks.body: Forgetting SendTaskSuccess — execution hangs until timeout. Token in logs — security leak. Sync Lambda chain for 20-minute total work — hits limits. Duplicate SQS delivery calling SendTaskSuccess twice — second call fails harmlessly if handled.

blocks.text: How to prove it in production: ExecutionsTimedOut metric correlates with missing SendTaskSuccess. Log taskToken hash not full token. Compare cost: N sync Lambda Tasks vs one token wait + batch worker. EventBridge Pipes SQS to Step Functions for alternative entry.

blocks.title: What gets you rejected in interviews
blocks.body: Saying 'Step Functions replaces SQS.' Strong answer: Step Functions orchestrates; SQS scales workers; combine with task token for long-running steps.

interviewTakeaways: Sync Lambda Task for quick steps; SQS sendMessage for fire-and-forget; waitForTaskToken for async completion.
Worker calls SendTaskSuccess with token from message body.
HeartbeatSeconds prevents timeout on long approvals.
60s: Token in SQS message. Worker SendTaskSuccess. Sync Lambda for fast steps. SQS scales heavy work.
Follow-up: how handle duplicate SQS delivery with task token?
commonPitfalls: Missing SendTaskSuccess — execution times out hours later.
Strong answer: worker idempotency + log token completion status.
Sync Lambda chain for entire saga — latency and limit issues.
Logging full task token — security exposure.

BullMQ job completion event resembles SendTaskSuccess — Step Functions is the parent workflow awaiting child job.
